scope: Echo/Pusher broadcast mesh: routes/channels.php + Persist*ToOutbox listeners + frontend onEvents subscribers + Heal-5 KdsOrderRecalled wiring + branch isolation + payload PII/auth-token scan.

channels_inventory.note: Laravel default user-self channel; no observed emit/subscribe in app/. Effectively dormant. 1 effective channel = branch.{id}.

channels_inventory.callback: kiosk-token clause + Admin/Tenant-Admin role clause + own-branch fallback
channels_inventory.note: Only Echo channel actually used. All 13 outbox broadcast_as values funnel here via private-branch.{branchId}.

emitters_inventory.channel_expr: private-branch.{branchId} (single if branchId set, else per-active-branch fan-out)

emitters_pattern_note: All emits go through the outbox pattern: domain event -> Persist*ToOutbox listener -> DomainEvent row -> DispatchDomainEventsJob -> BroadcastManager::connection()->broadcast(channels, broadcast_as, envelope). No direct broadcast() calls anywhere in app/. No ShouldBroadcast classes (only OrderCreated.php mentions ShouldBroadcastNow in a doc comment referencing the legacy direct pattern that was replaced).
subscribers_pattern_note: All subscribers route through resources/js/services/eventContract.js::onEvents -> window.Echo.private(`branch.${branchId}`).listen(`.${broadcastAs}`, handler). No raw .listen() calls outside the helper. Bootstrap (resources/js/bootstrap.js) wraps Echo.private/encryptedPrivate/join with subscription-error binders.

heal_5_evidence.event_class: app/Events/KdsOrderRecalled.php (uses DispatchableAfterCommit; ctor: orderId, branchId, queueNumber, actorId, recalledAt, correlationId)
heal_5_evidence.frontend_subscriber: resources/js/components/admin/kitchenDisplaySystem/KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1933-1946 (onEvents binding { broadcastAs: 'KdsOrderRecalled', handler: -> onKdsOrderRecalled({orderId, queueNumber, recalledAt, payload}) })
heal_5_evidence.deliberate_omissions_note: Listener does NOT chain SendOrderMail/SendOrderSms/FCM (recall is internal kitchen only; customer-facing OSS already notified on initial PREPARING->PREPARED). Idempotency key sha1(event_type|order_id|recalled_at|correlation_id) collapses listener replays while allowing genuine second recall in distinct request.
heal_5_evidence.contract_map_php_omission_note: EventContract::BROADCAST_MAP (app/Domain/Events/EventContract.php:34-49) does NOT enumerate 'KdsOrderRecalled' -> 'kds.order_recalled'. EventContract::typeForBroadcastAs() falls back to the raw broadcast_as name if the map does not cover it, but DispatchDomainEventsJob actually uses domain_event.event_type (read directly from the row) for envelope.type, so the omission is currently HARMLESS. EventContract::REQUIRED_PAYLOAD_KEYS (lines 55-76) also has no entry for KDS_ORDER_RECALLED, so assertPayloadValid() short-circuits (line 159 'Unknown types pass') and the recall payload is broadcast unvalidated. Same omission applies to SETTINGS_UPDATED, BRANCH_STATUS_CHANGED, MENU_EXTRA_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED, MENU_VARIATION_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED. P2 backlog: add entries so future drift is caught at boundary.

branch_isolation_evidence.kiosk_token_restriction: routes/channels.php:44-50 - tokenName === 'kiosk-token' triggers KioskMachine lookup with withoutGlobalScope(BranchScope) and asserts (int) $machine->branch_id === (int) $branchId. Comment cites F-SEC-W6-01 fix away from $user->tokenCan('kiosk:order') (which was satisfied by admin '*' wildcard tokens) to token-name string match (un-spoofable).
branch_isolation_evidence.guest_echo_bypass_closed: routes/channels.php:56-58 - Admin/Tenant-Admin branch_id=0 path now uses $user->hasRole('Admin') || hasRole('Tenant Admin'), NOT a bare branch_id===0 sentinel. Closes F-SEC-W6-02 latent path where customers/guests seeded with branch_id=0 could subscribe to any branch.
branch_isolation_evidence.staff_fallback: routes/channels.php:60-61 - non-admin/non-kiosk-token must have (int) $user->branch_id === (int) $branchId. Hard equality, no string coercion edge.
branch_isolation_evidence.channel_payload_scoping: Every Persist*ToOutbox listener encodes channel as private-branch.{branchId} via json_encode(['private-branch.' . X]). DispatchDomainEventsJob:101-105 parses the JSON array and fans each channel; no path lets a row leak to a different branch.
branch_isolation_evidence.fan_out_safety: Fan-out listeners (PersistCatalogChanged, PersistSettingsUpdated, PersistItemAvailability when branchId is null) build the channel list by querying active branches and produce private-branch.{id} per branch -- not a wildcard or broad pattern.

channel_auth_bypasses_note: routes/channels.php has ONE 'return true;' at line 57, inside the Admin/Tenant-Admin role gate (lines 56-58). It is gated by an explicit role check, NOT a bare return-true bypass. No other unconditional returns in channels.php. The user-self channel (App.Models.User.{id}) returns a strict integer comparison.

orphan_emits.rationale: Backend emits OrderPaymentStatusChanged broadcasts on every payment_status transition (PHASE 1 / P13 audit), but zero frontend subscriber binds broadcastAs: 'OrderPaymentStatusChanged'. Wasted broadcast traffic + EventContract enforces REQUIRED_PAYLOAD_KEYS so each emit goes through validation cost. Recommended: either wire a POS/KDS subscriber (and reuse the payload's old_status/new_status/total/fiscal_sequence_no fields) or downgrade the listener to a non-broadcast DB-only outbox row.

Wave 5G R10 / T-6.4 listener persists + fans out a branch ACTIVE->INACTIVE transition to private-branch.{id}, but no frontend subscriber (KioskApp, POS, KDS) listens for it. The companion RevokeTokensOnBranchDeactivated listener does the security-critical Sanctum revoke synchronously, so the broadcast is purely informational and currently lands in the void.

Wave 5G R9 heal explicitly designed this to be consumed by POS/Kiosk to refresh frontend/setting payload live, but grep shows zero JS subscriber on broadcastAs: 'SettingsUpdated'. The promised live refresh is not actually wired -- surfaces still pick up settings via their normal fetch on remount/login. Worse, the listener fans out one outbox row per active branch, so the waste is multiplied N times per admin save.

orphan_subscribers.rationale: Frontend listens for broadcastAs: 'ComposerProfileChanged', but ComposerProfileChanged::class is mapped in EventServiceProvider.php:284-287 to [InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange, PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox] -- both of which broadcast as 'CatalogChanged' (see PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox.php:84). There is NO Persist*ComposerProfileChanged listener anywhere in app/Listeners/. The Pusher channel will never carry an event with broadcast_as='ComposerProfileChanged' -> dead handler. Belt-and-suspenders fallback only: CatalogChanged is also bound on the same channel and DOES fire.
orphan_subscribers.severity: P2 (dead code, but cart/menu still refresh via CatalogChanged sibling binding)

payload_integrity_findings.rationale: Payload includes 'token' => $order->token. Order::token is a fillable column (app/Models/Order.php:24,72) used by online payment integrations (Stripe/PayPal payment intent reference; OrderService.php:2286,2293 sets it from request->token; legacy 'TXN-'.Str::random(12) for sim). It is NOT a Sanctum auth token and is NOT used for guest order tracking lookup (grep of OrderTrackController found no usage). It IS a payment-provider reference. Risk profile: low (payment refs are not directly exploitable, channel is private-branch.{id} branch-gated, branch staff already see order detail), but it is a payload field whose business purpose downstream is unclear -- no JS handler reads parsed.payload.token in the inventoried subscribers. Recommendation: drop the field from the payload unless an explicit consumer is wired, to keep envelope minimal and avoid widening attack surface if Stripe/PayPal references ever change shape.

payload_integrity_clean_findings: OrderCreated payload: order_id, queue_number, _origin, payment_method, payment_status, payment_pending_counter, status, order_type, total, created_at -- NO PII (no customer name/email/phone/address), no tokens.
OrderPaidAtCounter payload: order_id, queue_number, _origin, payment_method, payment_status, fiscal_sequence_no -- clean.
KdsOrderRecalled payload: order_id, branch_id, queue_number, actor_id, recalled_at -- clean (actor_id is staff user id, which is a branch-scoped non-secret).
ItemAvailabilityChanged payload: item_id, status, price, type, is_available, branch_id, reason -- catalog data, no PII.
CatalogChanged payload: entity_type, entity_id, change_type, branch_id, snapshot_version, payload_diff -- catalog data, no PII.
additional_observations: EventContract PHP BROADCAST_MAP (app/Domain/Events/EventContract.php:34-49) is stale relative to the active broadcast set. Missing entries: KdsOrderRecalled, BranchStatusChanged, SettingsUpdated, ItemExtraAvailabilityChanged, ItemVariationAvailabilityChanged, ComposerProfileChanged. Today this is harmless because typeForBroadcastAs() falls back to the raw name AND DispatchDomainEventsJob reads event_type from the DomainEvent row (not via BROADCAST_MAP), but it is a drift that defeats the contract's stated SoT purpose. Same drift in REQUIRED_PAYLOAD_KEYS (lines 55-76).

Frontend EVENT_TYPES (resources/js/services/eventContract.js:1-16) and BROADCAST_MAP (lines 18-29) are similarly stale. Missing entries: BranchStatusChanged, SettingsUpdated, ItemExtraAvailabilityChanged, ItemVariationAvailabilityChanged, ComposerProfileChanged, OrderPaymentStatusChanged. onEvents() warns on mismatch (line 356) but does NOT block -- handler still fires. Stale map = lost warning fidelity.
ComposerProfilePublished event class exists (app/Events/ComposerProfilePublished.php) but no dispatch site found in app/. Stale class candidate for removal (separate audit).

The Laravel-default 'App.Models.User.{id}' channel callback is intact but appears dormant -- no observed emit on this channel pattern and no .private('App.Models.User.X') subscriber in the JS. Either retain as scaffolding or remove for clarity.

Bootstrap pipeline (resources/js/bootstrap.js:383-393) correctly wraps Echo.private + encryptedPrivate + join with subscription-error binders. WebSocketService (resources/js/services/WebSocketService.js) provides heartbeat + degraded-state UX. ws:heartbeat cache is stamped by DispatchDomainEventsJob:129 on every successful broadcast (Pusher liveness probe).

Per-subscriber polling fallback discipline is consistent: KDS branch_id<=0 -> return (admin polling); Kiosk silently swallows Echo failures; eventContract.onEvents returns no-op subscription if window.Echo absent or branchId 0/null. Surfaces are NOT broken by a Pusher outage.
verdict_rationale: GREEN gates met: (1) channel auth callbacks have no bare 'return true' bypass; (2) branch isolation is hardened by the kiosk-token name check + Admin/Tenant-Admin role gate; (3) every emitter funnels onto private-branch.{id} -- no cross-branch broadcast paths; (4) Heal-5 KdsOrderRecalled is fully wired emit-side (PersistKdsOrderRecalledToOutbox -> outbox -> DispatchDomainEventsJob) AND subscribe-side (KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.subscribeEcho binding lines 1933-1946); (5) payloads contain no PII and no Sanctum/auth tokens. AMBER drivers: 3 orphan emits (OrderPaymentStatusChanged, BranchStatusChanged, SettingsUpdated -- two of them explicitly designed to be consumed but never wired in JS), 1 orphan subscriber (ComposerProfileChanged on the kiosk -- handler will never fire because the event is rebroadcast as CatalogChanged), 1 P3 payload concern (OrderStatusChanged.token is a payment-provider ref of unclear consumer), and stale EventContract maps both PHP-side and JS-side. None are P0/P1 -- broadcast mesh is functionally safe -- but they violate the 'GREEN = zero waste/drift' bar. P2/P3 backlog before GREEN.
